lead: A `gaps.py` "no case calls X" is a claim about the cases it *attributed* to that class, and attribution is not coverage.
body: `coverage`'s attribution follows produced instance types (`gaps.py`'s `producers`), so a value reached through a factory on another class is counted, but a member exercised only through a closure or a helper class the walk cannot follow still reads as uncalled — the number is a floor, never a count. `python tools/gaps.py --member <name>` prints the cases that already ask about one: one call, before writing a case the tree already has.
